basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 13.' and it opens 'Vers. 13. Abjecit Agar puerum. Non quo eum in scapula portaret qui, quando circumcisus'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 13. Abjecit Agar puerum. Non quo eum in scapula portaret qui, quando circumcisus est, tredecim annorum: sed abjecit eum ab animo et cura sua eum repulit. Sic enim usualiter loqui solemus: abjeci ex animo.
